claims.claim: For spin j>=1 the optimal tracial linear-spin envelope has derivative Gprime=(2j/(2j-1))Lprime-(j²/(2j-1))sum(h)I at isotropy.
claims.quantifiers: Every fixed j>=1 and every real anisotropy direction h; every optimal envelope satisfies this expansion.
premises: exact unrestricted pure-state tracial ensemble support
nonnegative weights in a neighborhood of (1,1,1)
claims.mechanism: Isotropic optimizer face consists of coherent states whose tracial reference fixes second directional moments; compact support derivative and positive coherent-symbol inverse imply envelope derivative.
not_assumed: global optimality of a guessed envelope

claims.claim: Any common-envelope scalar register allocation positive near isotropy must use reference fraction alpha_j=(2j+1)/(4j+1).
claims.quantifiers: Every spin j>=1; every nonzero trace-zero infinitesimal anisotropy.
claims.isotropic_equality_space: BC spin2j coupled to A spinj to total spinj.
claims.unequal_outputs: Only the sum of output fractions enters; same reference fraction is forced.
claims.separate_L_G_allocations: Necessary (n-1)a+n b=n-1/(2n+1); no spin-independent constants a,b obey this for all n.
claims.scope: Necessity for this operator proof interface, not a C2 channel theorem.

claims.claim: The universal fixed3/5 common-envelope operator allocation fails at a specific positive rational weight triple already at spin3/2.
claims.support_envelope_scope: Every exact optimal unrestricted tracial convex-roof envelope G; no numerical optimizer premise.
claims.mechanism: Exact tangent -3/100 plus feasible quadratic dual upper bound and coherent inverse remainder ||H||<=945 epsilon², epsilon1/63000.
claims.reason: The operator test vector is nontracial.

claims.claim: Single-observable support is exact k=V with unique G=Jz²; allowed common allocation fractions are [(j-1)/(2j-1),j/(2j-1)] for j>=1.
claims.quantifiers: Every spin j>=1; every product magnetic eigenvector in all three registers.

claims.claim: Every unital self-compatible channel on spinj admits one canonical EB C2 comparator on span{I,Jx,Jy,Jz}, without channel covariance.
claims.quantifiers: Every spin j; every such supplied channel; one comparator independent of chosen linear observable.
claims.revised_operator_gate: For every weight triple, an optimal even G with alpha_j(L+G)_A+(1-alpha_j)((L+G)_B+(L+G)_C)/2>=W.
claims.direct_gate_if_operator_fails: Maximize star over actual legal tracial joint Choi states and compare with V+k.
claims.next_decisive_observation: Second-order equality-space Schur complement for alpha_j, or an exact negative alpha_j witness; for actual falsification also require legal tracial state and unrestricted support upper proof.
